plain.text: As they left the temple, Jesus said not one stone would be left on another. On the Mount of Olives the disciples asked when this would happen and what would be the sign of his coming and the end of the age. Jesus warned them not to be deceived. There would be wars, famines and earthquakes, but these are the beginning of birth pains. His followers would be hated and persecuted, and many would fall away, but whoever stands firm to the end will be saved. The good news of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world.

When they see the abomination of desolation Daniel spoke of, those in Judea must flee to the mountains without delay. There would be great distress. False messiahs and false prophets would perform signs to deceive, if possible, even God's chosen ones. See, I have told you ahead of time.

Don't believe people who say the Messiah is out in the wilderness or in a secret room. The coming of the Son of Man will be like lightning flashing across the sky. The sun and moon will darken, the sign of the Son of Man will appear, and all the peoples will see him coming on the clouds with power and great glory, and he will gather his chosen ones. Learn from the fig tree: when its leaves appear, summer is near. Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.

No one knows the day or hour, not the angels, nor the Son, but only the Father. It will be like the days of Noah, when people went on with life until the flood came. So keep watch, because you do not know when your Lord will come. Be like the faithful servant whom the master finds doing his job when he returns, not the wicked one who thinks his master is delayed and mistreats others.

summary.bigIdea: Jesus warns of hard times and false messiahs, and promises he will come again, so his followers must stay faithful and ready.
points: He warns against deception and calls for endurance.
No one knows the day or hour, so keep watch.
summary.reflection: Heaven and earth will pass away, but Jesus' words will not. How does that steady you?
